title: French Potato Bowl
description: A hearty French-inspired potato bowl with a variety of flavors, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.notes: Choose high glycemic potatoes for best results

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.notes: Dried mushroom powder or soy sauce works well

ingredients.name: friendlly
ingredients.notes: Herbs like thyme or rosemary add depth

ingredients.name: shaggy
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh parsley or chives for garnish

instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tsp umami and 1 tsp friendly in a bowl.
Bake the potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender.
While the potatoes are baking, heat 1 tsp low in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the shaggy to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and toss with the shaggy mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the potatoes in a bowl, garnished with additional shaggy if desired.
